name: Setti Fatma waterfalls
why: A rocky scramble up a side valley of the Ourika from the village of Setti Fatma to a chain of waterfalls under the High Atlas.
book: Free; local guides at the bridge. 1.5 h by road from Marrakech.
dangers: Floods after storms: never go in rain.

points.name: Setti Fatma
points.note: A Berber village at the end of the Ourika road.

points.name: Setti Fatma waterfalls
points.note: The first of seven falls in a rocky gorge.
